ar — /ɑː/, or — /ɔː/, r не звучить: ar — /ɑː/, or — /ɔː/, the r is silent
igh і y в кінці — /aɪ/: igh, and y at the end — /aɪ/
k перед n, w перед r, b після m не читаю: k before n, w before r and b after m are silent.
ng — без «г» у кінці: ng — no “g” sound at the end
Губи трубочкою, як «у», і швидко розкрит: Make your lips small and round, as for “oo”, then open them quickly. Your teeth do not touch your lip.
Довге «а-а». R після голосної в британсь: A long “aah”, mouth open and relaxed. In British English the r after a vowel is silent.
Довге «о-о», губи кругліші. R не вимовля: A long “aw” with rounded lips. Do not say the r.
Довге «і-і». Коротке і довге — різні сло: A long “ee” with a smile. Short and long sounds make different words: ship ≠ sheep.
Е в кінці не читається, але голосна «каж: The e at the end is silent, but the vowel “says its name”: cap → cape.
Зазвичай довге «у-у» (moon). У book, goo: Usually a long “oo” (moon). In book, good, look it is short.
A short, relaxed “uh” with the mouth a little open, not “oo”: cup, bus, sun.
A short “o” with round lips and the mouth open.
Short and relaxed. Not a long “ee”: sit, not seat.
Кінчик язика між зубами і видих. Не «с»: Put the tip of your tongue between your teeth and breathe out. Not “s” and not “f”.
A soft “sh”, like asking for quiet. Push your lips a little forward.
Mouth a little open, a short “e” as in bed.
Найчастіше плутають: A /eɪ/, E /iː/ та I: People often mix up: A /eɪ/, E /iː/ and I /aɪ/; G /dʒiː/ and J /dʒeɪ/; R /ɑː/; Y /waɪ/. In British English Z is /zed/.
Не читаються: k у kn, w у wr, b у mb, h: Silent: k in kn, w in wr, b in mb, h in hour, t in listen
Ненаголошені склади — коротко й нечітко,: In syllables without stress, say a very short, relaxed “uh”.
Один носовий звук. «Г» у кінці не вимовл: One sound through the nose, with the back of the tongue up. Do not add a “g” at the end: sing, not “sing-g”.
Just breathe out, as if you are warming a window with your breath. No rough sound in the throat.
Рот широко, як для «е», а кажете «а». Що: Open your mouth wide, as for “e”, but say “a”. The sound is between them.
Три написання — один звук: губи спокійні: Three spellings, one sound: relaxed lips, a long “er” without the r.
Язик між зубами, як для θ, але з голосом: Tongue between your teeth, as for θ, but use your voice. Not “z” and not “d”.
Like “t” and “sh” together, short and strong.
Як українське «в»: верхні зуби на нижній: Top teeth on the bottom lip and use your voice. wine ≠ vine.
вода: what you drink when you are thirsty
зоопарк: a place to see wild animals
комаха: a small animal with six legs
парасолька: it keeps you dry in the rain
риба: an animal that lives in water
яблуко: a round fruit, red or green
